hook.text: Interviewer bola: ek URL shortener design karo.
hook.say: Interviewer bola. Ek U R L shortener design karo.

hook.text: Sirf saat characters. Har din das crore naye links.
Code kabhi repeat nahi hona chahiye. Kaise karoge?

trap.text: Sabka pehla jawab: random code bana do.
Par das din mein, ek arab links. Aur ek lakh se zyada collisions.
Har collision pe database check, phir retry. System dheema.

logic.text: Sahi tareeka: ek counter rakho. Har link ko agla number.
Phir us number ko base 62 mein likho.
logic.say: Phir us number ko base baasath mein likho.

logic.text: Sau pachees arab ka number, sirf saat characters mein.
Number kabhi dobara nahi aata. Zero collisions.

build.text: Ab koi link kholta hai. Pehle Redis cache dekho.
build.say: Ab koi link kholta hai. Pehle Redis cache dekho.

build.text: Miss hua toh database se lo, aur cache mein rakh do.
Uske baad har click: ek millisecond se kam.

twist.text: Twist: ek hi counter? Saare servers wahin atak jayenge.
Toh har server ek baar mein hazaar IDs ka block le leta hai.
Aur codes guess na ho, isliye number ko shuffle karke encode karo.

recap.text: Recap: counter, base 62, cache, aur ID blocks.
recap.say: Recap. Counter, base baasath, cache, aur I D blocks.

recap.text: Agle episode mein: rate limiter. Follow kar lo.
